request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:GUARD

layers.text: Change only his clothes and shield: take off the red tunic so his chest and arms are bare skin, with two crossed brown leather straps and a brown leather kilt to the knees, dull mid-brown #955627 with #562a0c shadows; the round shield becomes dark brown planks (#5c3a22) with a rusted iron rim and an iron boss, no red skull; remove the red skull badge from his arm. No red left. Keep the pot helmet, his skin, tusks, face, cleaver, boots, pose, proportions, black outline and art style the same.
